claims.text: Prime Minister Lord Tu'ivakano announces that King George Tupou V died in Hong Kong, China, at 15:58 (Hong Kong, China time), which was 20:58 (Tonga time), on 18 March 2012.
claims.locator: PDF page 1 (gazette page 8/113), English and Tongan notices
claims.uncertainty: Official death notice. The mourning it declares is a separate claim (to_crown_gtv_mourning_declared_20120319).

claims.text: The same notice declares State mourning for three months from 19 March 2012, ending 19 June 2012, with flags at half-mast throughout the Kingdom.
claims.uncertainty: A mourning instrument, later revoked and replaced (to_crown_gtv_mourning_revised_20120330); not a reign boundary.

scope_note: Bilingual gazette; the Tongan-language link returns a byte-identical file. Used for the death notice and the mourning it declares.
